products.title: Mint (Pudina)
products.description: Fresh Kashmir mint plant. Aromatic leaves for chutneys and garnishing.

growing_instructions: Plant rooted runners in partial sun with moist, fertile, well-drained soil.
Use containers or root barriers to prevent aggressive spreading.
Pinch shoot tips early to encourage bushy leaf growth.
care_instructions: Keep soil consistently moist, especially in dry summer periods.
Feed lightly with compost every 4-6 weeks during active growth.
Harvest regularly before flowering for best aroma and tenderness.
Rejuvenate clumps yearly by dividing overcrowded plants.
